name: Bauble of Abundance banishes itself so each player draws a card
notes: Bauble of Abundance's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed; it is seeded directly onto the field (REGALIA convention). Its ability is banish-self at zero reserve cost: a single CustomInput Activate click draws a card for the activating player, draws a card for the opponent, and moves the bauble to myBanish.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Each player draws a card.
